papers.title: Conversion of Hip Hemiarthroplasty to Total Hip Arthroplasty Utilizing a Dual-Mobility Construct Compared With Large Femoral Heads
papers.first_author_affiliation: Department of Orthopedic Surgery, Mayo Clinic, Rochester, Minnesota

corresponding_authors.name: Matthew P. Abdel
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Department of Orthopedic Surgery, Mayo Clinic, Rochester, Minnesota

llm.relevance_to_user: 与用户研究方向（髋关节植入物生物力学）无关，为临床手术比较研究。
llm.why_not_core: No quantification of stress shielding, micromotion, or finite element analysis; purely clinical outcomes without biomechanical modeling or implant design evaluation.

summary_zh.motivation: 比较转换髋关节半髋置换至全髋置换时使用双动白杯与大股骨头的临床效果。
summary_zh.method: 回顾性临床研究，比较两组患者的并发症、再手术率和功能结局。
summary_zh.result: 双动白杯组脱位率低于大股骨头组，但其他并发症无显著差异。
summary_zh.validation: 临床随访数据统计比较。

summary_en.motivation: To compare clinical outcomes of conversion hip hemiarthroplasty to total hip arthroplasty using dual-mobility constructs versus large femoral heads.
summary_en.method: Retrospective clinical study comparing complication rates, reoperation rates, and functional outcomes between two groups.
summary_en.result: The dual-mobility group had lower dislocation rates than the large femoral head group, but other complications were not significantly different.
summary_en.validation: Statistical comparison of clinical follow-up data.

papers.title: Structural components manufactured by Selective Laser Melting and Investment Casting—Impact of the process route on the damage mechanism under cyclic loading
papers.first_author_affiliation: DMRC (Direct Manufacturing Research Center), Mersinweg 3, 33098 Paderborn, Germany

corresponding_authors.name: Stefan Leuders
corresponding_authors.affiliation: DMRC (Direct Manufacturing Research Center), Mersinweg 3, 33098 Paderborn, Germany

llm.relevance_to_user: 这篇论文主要关注选择性激光熔化和熔模铸造的结构部件在循环加载下的损伤机制，与生物医学植入物或应力屏蔽等方向无关。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not address biomedical implants, porous structures, stress shielding, stiffness matching, osseointegration, or any biomedical context; it focuses on general structural component fatigue.

summary_zh.motivation: 比较SLM和熔模铸造对结构部件疲劳损伤机制的影响
summary_zh.method: 通过循环加载实验分析两种工艺路径下的损伤演化
summary_zh.result: SLM和熔模铸造的损伤机制存在差异，影响疲劳寿命
summary_zh.validation: 基于标准疲劳实验的力学测试验证

summary_en.motivation: To compare the damage mechanisms under cyclic loading of structural components manufactured by selective laser melting and investment casting.
summary_en.method: Cyclic loading experiments were conducted on specimens from both process routes to analyze damage evolution.
summary_en.result: Different damage mechanisms were observed between SLM and investment casting, influencing fatigue life.
summary_en.validation: Validation through standard mechanical fatigue testing on manufactured specimens.
